targets.rawSql: SELECT t.full_timestamp AS "time", b.building_name AS metric, AVG(f.avg_traffic_mbps) AS value FROM fact_device_metric_hourly f JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = f.building_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = f.time_key WHERE $__timeFilter(t.full_timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.date_value::timestamp AS "time", b.building_name AS metric, AVG(f.sla_compliance_pct) AS value FROM fact_sla_window f JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = f.building_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = f.time_key WHERE $__timeFilter(t.full_timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.full_timestamp AS "time", b.building_name AS metric, AVG(f.latency_p95_ms) AS value FROM fact_sla_window f JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = f.building_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = f.time_key WHERE $__timeFilter(t.full_timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.full_timestamp AS "time", b.building_name AS metric, SUM(f.avg_clients) AS value FROM fact_device_metric_hourly f JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = f.building_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = f.time_key WHERE $__timeFilter(t.full_timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.full_timestamp AS "time", b.building_name AS metric, AVG(f.packet_loss_pct) AS value FROM fact_sla_window f JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = f.building_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = f.time_key WHERE $__timeFilter(t.full_timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT issue_type, SUM(inserted_count) AS inserted_count, SUM(caught_count) AS caught_count FROM fact_data_quality GROUP BY issue_type ORDER BY issue_type

SELECT t.full_timestamp, b.building_name, at.alert_name, a.severity, a.message FROM fact_alert a JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = a.building_key JOIN dim_alert_type at ON at.alert_type_key = a.alert_type_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = a.time_key WHERE $__timeFilter(t.full_timestamp) ORDER BY t.full_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT b.building_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.severity IN ('high', 'critical')) AS high_severity_count FROM fact_alert a JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = a.building_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = a.time_key WHERE t.full_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY b.building_name ORDER BY alert_count DESC, high_severity_count DESC

SELECT t.full_timestamp, b.building_name, a.severity, a.message FROM fact_alert a JOIN dim_building b ON b.building_key = a.building_key JOIN dim_alert_type at ON at.alert_type_key = a.alert_type_key JOIN dim_time t ON t.time_key = a.time_key WHERE at.alert_code = 'TRAFFIC_ANOMALY' AND $__timeFilter(t.full_timestamp) ORDER BY t.full_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
